prompts.prompt: Build a literature-review workflow over the frozen local corpus in tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr1_corpus/. The workflow should read the markdown papers from disk, extract findings from each paper in parallel, group the findings by theme, draft a literature review, run a reviewer loop, and write the final review to markdown. Treat the local corpus as the only source of truth; do not replace it with web search.
artifact_assertions: writes a final markdown literature review
extracts findings from each local paper
groups findings by theme before drafting

prompts.prompt: Build a data-analysis workflow over the frozen package in tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr2_data/. The workflow should read tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr2_data/sales_metrics.csv, compare its computed totals against tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr2_data/expected_summary.json, run Python code to compute the totals and average revenue per unit, produce a markdown report, and fail honestly if the code stage cannot be made runnable.
artifact_assertions: computes totals from the frozen CSV
checks the computed values against the reference summary

prompts.prompt: Build a code-migration workflow for the frozen repo fixture in tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr3_repo/. The workflow should inspect the local Python package, identify the Python-2-only constructs, apply migration edits, run the tests in tests/fixtures/benchmark_prep/lr3_repo/tests/, loop on failures, and produce a final migration report. Use the local repo fixture as the only source of truth.
artifact_assertions: runs the local test suite after edits
